Lower Text: [Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, by placing 2 [Vemmon] from 1 of your [Galacticmon]'s digivolution cards at the bottom of their owners' decks, switch the target of attack to this Digimon.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Place 1 [Vemmon] among them under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Trash the rest. Then, if there are 5 or more [Vemmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Tamers.
